title: This Startup Raised $200M on Users That Don't Exist
description:
A startup raised $200M on users that dont exist 😅

Simile builds AI simulations of real people for market research. Founded by the guy behind Smallville, where AI agents mimicked real human lives for years. CVS Health already pays for synthetic panels instead of focus groups ✨

$300M in five months. Real people in research are getting priced out 🔥

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
